<?php
enum PipeSelected: string { case One = 'one'; }
enum PipeRebound: string { case Other = 'one'; }
class PipeLeftString {
    public function __toString(): string {
        global $target;
        $target = [PipeRebound::class, 'from'];
        echo 'CAST|';
        return 'one';
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'DROP|'; }
}
$target = [PipeSelected::class, 'from'];
$result = (new PipeLeftString) |> $target;
echo $result === PipeSelected::One ? 'selected|' : 'BAD|';
echo $target('one') === PipeRebound::Other ? 'rebound|' : 'BAD|';
purpose: Pipe selects the original enum array target before the forced left Stringable callback rebinds it; temporary destruction precedes lookup.

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
enum PipeStrict: int { case One = 1; }
try { $result = '1' |> 'PipeStrict::from'; } catch (TypeError $e) { echo 'string-type|'; }
try { $result = '1' |> [PipeStrict::class, 'tryFrom']; } catch (TypeError $e) { echo 'array-type|'; }
try { $result = '1' |> [PipeStrict::One, 'from']; } catch (TypeError $e) { echo 'case-type|'; }
echo (1 |> 'PipeStrict::from') === PipeStrict::One ? 'string-ok|' : 'BAD|';
echo (1 |> [PipeStrict::class, 'tryFrom']) === PipeStrict::One ? 'array-ok|' : 'BAD|';
purpose: Strict pipe calls reject string-to-int conversion for method strings, class arrays and case-object arrays, then accept integer values.

<?php
enum PipeCase: string { case A = 'a'; case B = 'b'; }
enum PipeOtherCase: string { case X = 'b'; }
class PipeCaseInput {
    public function __toString(): string {
        global $target;
        $target = [PipeOtherCase::X, 'from'];
        echo 'CASE-CAST|';
        return 'b';
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'CASE-DROP|'; }
}
$target = [PipeCase::A, 'from'];
$result = (new PipeCaseInput) |> $target;
echo $result === PipeCase::B ? 'case-selected|' : 'BAD|';
echo ('b' |> $target) === PipeOtherCase::X ? 'case-rebound|' : 'BAD|';
try { $all = 'ignored' |> [PipeCase::A, 'cases']; } catch (ArgumentCountError $e) { echo 'arity|'; }
purpose: An enum-case receiver selects generated methods before a Stringable callback and preserves cases arity errors.

try { $value = (new PipeDrop) |> 'PipeNoArgs::cases'; }
